limitations: Single seed and adaptively inspected VOC validation set. Paired bootstrap measures image-sampling uncertainty, not training-seed variance. Fusion alpha 0.5 was fixed before OLC. CAM diagnostics use validation image tags, whereas segmentation does not. Offline label metrics do not supervise training.
conclusion: This seed-0 run improved old-label precision/F1 but not final segmentation. Keep the no-OLC restored prototype method as the recommended configuration; retain OLC as an experimental candidate. Image-bootstrap intervals include zero and do not measure training-seed variability.
